text: Endel Tulving's taxonomy classifies your knowledge that 'Paris is the capital of France' — held without any recollection of when or where you learned it — as which type of memory?
explanation: Semantic memory is decontextualized, atemporal factual knowledge held without any recollection of the learning episode. Episodic memory is memory for personally experienced events indexed to a time and place; procedural memory is skill/know-how; and 'autonoetic' names the self-in-time awareness that marks episodic memory, not a memory type in Tulving's threefold scheme.
